nerveProfiles.name: Femoral
nerveProfiles.course: Lateral psoas → psoas–iliacus interval → behind inguinal ligament, lateral to artery and sheath.
nerveProfiles.motor: All anterior thigh muscles except psoas major.
nerveProfiles.skin: Anterior thigh; saphenous continues to medial lower limb.

nerveProfiles.name: Obturator
nerveProfiles.course: Medial psoas → lateral pelvic wall → upper obturator foramen → anterior / posterior divisions.
nerveProfiles.motor: Anterior: brevis, longus, gracilis. Posterior: externus, brevis, adductor part of magnus.

nerveProfiles.name: Sciatic
nerveProfiles.course: Greater sciatic foramen below piriformis → deep to maximus and long head of biceps → upper popliteal split.
nerveProfiles.motor: Tibial part: long head of biceps, semitendinosus, semimembranosus, hamstring part of magnus. Common peroneal part: short head of biceps.
nerveProfiles.skin: Injury: loss below knee except medial saphenous strip.
nerveProfiles.joints: Articular branches are not specified for sciatic itself on these slides.

nerveProfiles.name: Tibial
nerveProfiles.course: Upper popliteal fossa → posterior leg deep to gastrocnemius / soleus → with posterior tibial artery deep to flexor retinaculum.
nerveProfiles.motor: All posterior leg muscles; plantar terminals continue to sole.
nerveProfiles.skin: Sural: back of leg + lateral foot. Medial calcaneal: heel.

nerveProfiles.name: Common peroneal
nerveProfiles.course: Popliteal fossa → fibular neck → splits inside peroneus longus into deep and superficial.
nerveProfiles.motor: Terminal branches: anterior and lateral leg compartments.
nerveProfiles.skin: Sural communicating + lateral cutaneous calf branches; terminals reach anterolateral leg and dorsum.

nerveProfiles.name: Deep peroneal
nerveProfiles.course: Anterior leg, deep to extensor digitorum longus.
nerveProfiles.motor: Anterior leg and dorsum foot muscles.
nerveProfiles.skin: Adjacent sides of first and second toes.

nerveProfiles.name: Superficial peroneal
nerveProfiles.course: Lateral compartment between peroneus longus and brevis.
nerveProfiles.skin: Lower anterolateral leg and dorsum foot.

nerveProfiles.name: Medial plantar
nerveProfiles.course: Begins deep to flexor retinaculum and continues into medial sole.
nerveProfiles.motor: First lumbrical, flexor digitorum brevis, flexor hallucis brevis, abductor hallucis.

nerveProfiles.name: Lateral plantar
nerveProfiles.course: Begins deep to flexor retinaculum and continues into lateral sole.

nerveProfiles.name: Pudendal
nerveProfiles.course: Greater → lesser sciatic foramen → pudendal canal with internal pudendal vessels.
nerveProfiles.motor: Inferior rectal: external anal sphincter. Perineal: all perineal muscles + external urethral sphincter.
nerveProfiles.skin: Inferior rectal: lower half anal canal. Perineal: scrotum / labia. Dorsal: penis / clitoris.

lesions.name: Femoral
lesions.cause: Stab / gunshot wounds; complete division rare.
lesions.position: Walking: presses distal thigh by hand

lesions.name: Sciatic
lesions.cause: Wound, pelvic fracture, hip dislocation, faulty gluteal injection; complete injury rare.
lesions.lost: Motor supply to the described muscles
lesions.skin: Below knee EXCEPT medial saphenous area; possible sole trophic ulcers
